newsitem.title: USA: Panatech to be sold to Titan Enterprises.
newsitem.headline: Panatech to be sold to Titan Enterprises.

text.p: Panatech Research and Development Corp said Tuesday it has entered into a letter of intent for Titan Enterprises Inc to acquire the company for about $34.6 million.
Under the proposed cash merger, Panatech shareholders would receive $7.00 for each share of common stock outstanding.

The letter of intent is the result of settlement proceedings concerning a patent infringement lawsuit filed by Panatech's wholly owned subsidiary, ASM Co Inc, against Titan Tool Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Titan Enterprises.
Panatech manufactures and sells accessories for high-pressure paint spraying equipment.
Titan Enterprises, a privately held company based in Oakland, N.J., produces airless and hydraulic paint spraying systems and related products.
